locator.verbatim: Molybdenite, 2H-MoS2, whose structure was first investigated by Dickinson and Pauling. The 2H-MoS2 is hexagonal and the structure is characterized by MoS2 layers with A-B-A stacking ... c = 12.30 A and a = 3.15 A ... sandwich-like layer stacking.
